tools.name: email-security_bec-pattern-detect
tools.description: Detect Business Email Compromise patterns such as payment-change language, executive persona cues, external Reply-To, and lookalike sender domains from supplied mail. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-security/bec-pattern-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: email-security_domain-impersonation-check
tools.description: Identify domains resembling supplied company or brand domains using edit distance, hyphen variants, homoglyph folding, and brand-token embedding. Resemblance is not proof of abuse. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-security/domain-impersonation-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms

tools.name: email-security_url-chain-analyze
tools.description: Analyze caller-supplied redirect hops or optionally follow public URLs with strict SSRF protections. Never sends email content to external scanners. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-security/url-chain-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: email-security_attachment-risk-analyze
tools.description: Inspect caller-supplied attachment filenames, metadata, and local magic-byte structures for suspicious patterns. No external sandbox or scanner is used. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/email-security/attachment-risk-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "email-security_phishing-signal-detect" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "email-security" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email-security_domain-impersonation-check · Private data: email-security_phishing-signal-detect, email-security_domain-impersonation-check · Public sink: email-security_header-forensics, email-security_spoofing-detect, email-security_phishing-signal-detect, email-security_bec-pattern-detect, email-security_domain-impersonation-check, email-security_url-chain-analyze, email-security_attachment-risk-analyze, email-security_conversation-tamper-detect · Destructive: email-security_header-forensics, email-security_spoofing-detect, email-security_phishing-signal-detect, email-security_bec-pattern-detect, email-security_domain-impersonation-check, email-security_url-chain-analyze, email-security_attachment-risk-analyze, email-security_conversation-tamper-detect.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email-security_domain-impersonation-check · Private data: email-security_phishing-signal-detect, email-security_domain-impersonation-check · Public sink: email-security_header-forensics, email-security_spoofing-detect, email-security_phishing-signal-detect, email-security_bec-pattern-detect, email-security_domain-impersonation-check, email-security_url-chain-analyze, email-security_attachment-risk-analyze, email-security_conversation-tamper-detect · Destructive: email-security_header-forensics, email-security_spoofing-detect, email-security_phishing-signal-detect, email-security_bec-pattern-detect, email-security_domain-impersonation-check, email-security_url-chain-analyze, email-security_attachment-risk-analyze, email-security_conversation-tamper-detect

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
